Voila is a new family of large voice-language foundation models aiming to lift human-AI interaction experiences to the next level. Breaking away from the constraints of traditional voice AI systems—high latency, loss of vocal nuances, and mechanical responses—Voila employs an innovative end-to-end model design and a novel… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/maitrix-org/Voila-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: composite (WER for ASR, MOS/human_eval for voice quality, and task accuracy for semantic/dialogue tasks)
reputation: A recently introduced benchmark for voice-language foundation models that is gaining attention among researchers building end-to-end multimodal voice assistants.
